title: Document localPosition of the rigid body markers and rotationMarker0/1 of the joints and connectors as deprecated, to be removed in favour of localHT
author: Claude-JG
description: The rigid body markers have localHT, the frame of the marker in the body, so that the joints and connectors need no rotationMarker0/1. The descriptions of localPosition of the rigid body markers and of rotationMarker0/1 of the joints and connectors say that they are deprecated and will be removed, and point to localHT. Decided: no deprecation warning yet, as rotationMarker0/1 are used frequently; the documentation only.
releaseNotes: The descriptions of localPosition of MarkerBodyRigid and MarkerKinematicTreeRigid and of rotationMarker0/1 of the joints and connectors say that they are deprecated and will be removed in favour of localHT of the rigid body markers; no warning yet.
